name: @brianjenkins94/run-contract
description: What brianjenkins94/editor reads from a run, and asks of it — the custom debug events a debugger sends (values, coverage, effects, ended, ask, recorded, listening, idle) and the requests it answers (decide, stdin, getCoverage) — and the workspace runtime a debugger's worker connects to (./runtime), span annotations — placing something on code so it stays on that code (./annotations) — pane views, a tab beside every editor drawn from an extension's data (./pane) — and what a debugger's worker uses to tell them: the live-values recorder (./values), recorded calls' values for replay (./recorded) and the gate's verdict by the policy (./gate). tsval's, and any interpreter plugged in as run.debugger.
